note: SKUniform of iOS 8: the value class and its iOS 8 surface. The members that arrived in iOS 10 and the deprecated floatVector/floatMatrix aliases are owed, and the rest of SpriteKit (SKAttribute and SKAttributeValue of iOS 9, SKShader, the nodes, the renderer) has no row yet.
